name: Takara Sushi (Logan) Baked "Fire Ball" Roll, "Crazy Boy" Roll & Spicy "Baja" Roll
whyItWorks: The Baked Fire Ball Roll (California roll baked with crab and shrimp) is fully cooked and warm; safe on good days if you ask for eel sauce only and hold spicy mayo.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Fire Ball Roll baked with sweet eel sauce only (no spicy sriracha mayo), and strictly avoid the Baja California Roll (topped with raw jalapeño and spicy tuna).
watchOuts: Strictly avoid the Baja California Roll (raw jalapeño & spicy tuna)
Deep-fried Crazy Boy Roll is high in fryer oil
